A card game called 99

Object is to not go over 99...easy peasy.

There must be at least 2 players and each player is given 3 random cards, face down. Once each player gets their 3 cards they can look at'em. The rest of the undelt cards are put in the center of the table. You will pull the top card from that deck once you play a card.

Doesn't matter who goes first. Whomever starts then the next player is the player to whomever start's left.

You start by pulling the top card from the cards that were not delt. Let's say that card is a jack, the value of the pot is at 10. The first player throws a queen, who's value is also 10. This brings the pot to 20. The next player throws a 7 in and the pot is at 27. Then just continue this process until the pot is 100 or greater. Basically you lose if you break 99.

The thing is there are 5 special cards.

9 = reverse. Basically instead of play going to whomever start's left, play now goes to the right. Then if another 9 is played, play goes back to the left.

4 = a value of 0. If the pot is at any value, let's say it is at 69, then a 4 is played next, the pot remains at 69.

Ace = a value of either 1 or 11. Player who plays the ace will decide it's value.

10 = either -10 or +10. If the pot is at 50 and a 10 is played. Whoever played the 10 decides if the pot either goes from 50 to either 40 or 60.

Kings = automatic 99. If the first card pulled is a king then the pot goes immediately to 99. If the pot is at any value then the pot immediately goes to 99, if a person plays a king. If you play a king on a king, the the pot remains at 99.

It's pretty straight forward and worth a play. It's my go-to card game to kill time with someone. Some of my buddies I play regularly and it's about as tense as the Russian roulette scene in The Deer Hunter.
I've played this before too and I really enjoy it! the special cards for when I play are a little different though. 9 is automatic 99 while 4 is reverse and 8 is pass. Still a fun game tho
